header.title: Text workshop
header.subtitle: Check, improve with AI and translate text: LanguageTool, house style, AI and DeepL on one page

steps.label: Steps
steps.pruefenTitle: Spelling, grammar and style with LanguageTool; for German text also the house style
steps.uebersetzenTitle: Translate with DeepL, with glossary, channel and form of address
steps.optimierenTitle: Revise with AI: correct, make clearer, shorten, make more persuasive and more, locally or in the cloud. German text only.
steps.pruefenHinweis: LanguageTool and the house style mark single spots with a suggestion. Only what is clicked is applied; the sentence structure stays as it is.
steps.optimierenHinweis: The AI revises the whole text according to the chosen type, including sentence structure and style. Afterwards numbers, names, house style and form of address are checked; applying comes only after the old/new comparison.
steps.uebersetzenHinweis: DeepL translates the text with glossary, channel and form of address.

lang.autoNotForTranslate: To translate, choose the language of the text. “Automatic” is only available for checking.

channel.checkTitle: Checks the house style of this channel
channel.checkOnlyGerman: The house style applies to German text only

check.markupHint: The mode is set to XML/HTML: LanguageTool also checks the tags. “Apply safe corrections” is therefore locked; accept suggestions one by one.

translate.stale: The text has changed since it was translated. Translate again to update.

optimieren.zielzeichenTitle: Optional: target length in characters, 20 to 10,000.
optimieren.channelTitle: The result is checked against the house style of this channel
optimieren.keineArten: No type of improvement is set up. An admin creates them under Administration › Admin › Improvement types.
optimieren.lokalHinweis: Local: the text goes in plain text to the in-house AI station. The route there passes through Cloudflare.
optimieren.cloudHinweis: Cloud: only the text from this preview goes out, with placeholders instead of names, prices and numbers. The result comes back with the real values.
optimieren.cloudWartet: For the cloud, wait for the preview below first.
optimieren.cloudRest: The preview still found a bank account, email address or phone number. Nothing is sent like this.
optimieren.placeholder: Nothing improved yet. Choose a type and the AI, then “Improve”.
optimieren.veraltet: The text has changed since it was improved. Applying is locked; please improve again.
optimieren.uebernommen: Applied. The text is on the left; Check and Translate now work with it.
optimieren.nurGanz: Original and result do not have the same number of paragraphs; can only be applied as a whole.

befund.verworfen: Rejected: the result fails a check. Applying is locked; improve again or choose another type.

code.HAUSSCHREIBWEISE_UNGEPRUEFT: The house style could not be read
code.ANREDE_NEU: A form of address was introduced ({{ist}}×)
code.ZAHL_VERTAUSCHT: The order of the values changed (swapped values?)
code.ANREDE_MEHRDEUTIG: “Sie” or “Ihr…” at the start of a sentence ({{ist}}×): formal address or plural? Please check
code.ANTWORT_ABGESCHNITTEN: The answer is cut off (limit reached)
code.CHANNEL_REGEL: Replaced by rule: {{neu}}. Check articles and endings

fehler.ART_UNBEKANNT: This type of improvement does not exist.
fehler.ART_INAKTIV: This type of improvement is switched off.
fehler.VORSCHAU_FEHLT: For the cloud, create the preview first.
fehler.HAUSSCHREIBWEISE: The house style cannot be read right now; without it nothing is improved.
fehler.SCHUTZREGELN: The protection rules cannot be read right now; without them nothing is improved.
fehler.WERT_IN_ANWEISUNG: The instruction contains a masked word. Nothing was sent; please tell an admin.
fehler.STIL_UNBEKANNT: This style profile does not exist.
fehler.STIL_INAKTIV: This style profile is switched off.
fehler.STIL_CHANNEL: This style profile belongs to another channel; please select that channel.
fehler.STIL_MIT_WERTEN: The style profile contains details the cloud must not see in plain text. Nothing was sent.
fehler.STIL_NICHT_FREIGEGEBEN: This version of the style profile is not released for the cloud. Nothing was sent.
fehler.STIL_VERALTET: The style profile has changed since the page was loaded. Please reload the page; nothing was sent.

absatzGrund.zahlen: The numbers in this paragraph differ from the original; can only be applied as a whole.
absatzGrund.markup: The tags in this paragraph differ from the original; can only be applied as a whole.
absatzGrund.hausschreibweise: This paragraph brings in an avoided term; can only be applied as a whole.
absatzGrund.werte: Names or details moved between paragraphs; can only be applied as a whole.
absatzGrund.anrede: With du/Sie only as a whole, otherwise both forms would be in the text.
absatzGrund.zuordnung: This paragraph does not clearly match the original paragraph; can only be applied as a whole.
absatzGrund.laenge: This paragraph became much longer or shorter; can only be applied as a whole.

optimieren.maskenWeg: Masks reset because the text changed: {{liste}}. Only what appears as a whole word in the text stays masked; an unmasking applies only to the text it was set for.
optimieren.kombinationVerworfen: The selected combination fails a check and was not applied:
optimieren.stilOhneTitle: Optional: a style profile. Its description is sent to the model as part of the instruction.
optimieren.stilTitle:
Version {{fassung}}. This description is sent to the model as part of the instruction:
{{beschreibung}}
optimieren.stilNichtCloud: This version of the style profile is not released for the cloud or contains detected details. Improve locally or ask an admin to release it.

channelSchritt.regel: Terms of channel {{code}} replaced by rule: {{liste}}. Please check articles and endings.
channelSchritt.offen: Terms of channel {{code}} not adjusted; the checked version stays ({{liste}}).

optimieren.stilGehtMit: With the style profile {{name}} (version {{fassung}}) this description is also sent to the model, without placeholders:

arten.hinweis: What the AI should do in the “Improve” step. The instruction goes to the model word for word. The checks afterwards always run; the type only sets how strict they are.
arten.regelZahlenKeineNeuen: numbers may be dropped, never added

formular.name: Name
formular.platzhalter: missing placeholders only as a note (shorten)
formular.umstellen: Order of the values may change

stil.hinweis: A description of the writing style and a few example sentences. Both are sent to the model as part of the instruction in the “Improve” step; the checks afterwards apply unchanged. A profile with a channel only applies in that channel, and its terms are adjusted afterwards.
stil.cloudUngeprueft: cloud not checked (protection rules not readable)

quelle.text: read from a pasted text ({{n}} characters, not stored)

formular.beispiele: Example sentences, one per line (only a model for tone and sentence structure)
formular.aktivHinweis: only with a description of at least 20 characters

einlesen.serverHinweis: The server fetches the page, not the browser. Only text comes back, without links or e-mail addresses.
einlesen.soSiehtEsDasModell: This is what the cloud model sees:
einlesen.abgeleitet: Derived in {{sek}} s and entered below. Please check and edit, then save.
einlesen.ohneMarken: The answer did not have the expected form; everything is in the description.

fehler.URL_UNGUELTIG: The address is invalid (http or https only, without credentials).
fehler.ZIEL_GESPERRT: This address is not on the public internet or uses a port other than 80 or 443; it will not be fetched.
fehler.ANTWORT: The address does not return a readable web page (error, too many redirects or no HTML).
fehler.ZU_GROSS: The page is larger than 2 MB.
fehler.KEIN_TEXT: The page has too little running text. Choose another page or paste the text.
fehler.STIL_VERALTET: The profile has been changed in the meantime. Please reload.
fehler.STIL_MIT_WERTEN: The profile contains detected details (names, numbers, prices, contact data). Remove them first, then release.

freigabe.alt: release was for version {{alt}}; now version {{n}}, not released
freigabe.hinweis: A profile only goes to the cloud in its released version. The rules do not detect every name: releasing means this version has been read and contains nothing internal. Every new version needs a new release.
freigabe.ansichtTitel: Release version {{n}} of “{{name}}” for the cloud
freigabe.ansichtHinweis: Exactly this text goes to the model in plain text with every cloud run using this profile. Release it if it contains no names, customers, projects, prices or internal details.
